job.title: Google Analytics Data Engineer
job.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join a large-scale digital delivery environment, building and maintaining data products that support digital services, dashboards and analytics.

You’ll work across GA4, Google Tag Manager, BigQuery and GCP, transforming large volumes of digital interaction data into reliable, secure and usable datasets.

This is a hands-on role in a “you build it, you run it” environment, with a strong focus on automation, data quality, resilience and continuous improvement. Experience of large-scale GTM container migrations is particularly valuable.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Build and maintain data pipelines and analytics solutions using GA4, GTM and BigQuery.
  • Develop and optimise large-scale datasets using SQL and GCP.
  • Implement data cleansing and controls to identify and prevent PII.
  • Manage GA4/GTM tagging, tracking and governance across multiple digital services.
  • Lead or contribute to large-scale GTM migrations, including planning, implementation and rollback.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting using Looker Studio.
  • Automate data collection and processing using Google Apps Script.
  • Troubleshoot complex analytics, JavaScript, tagging and cloud issues.
  • Provide technical support and produce clear documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with multidisciplinary agile teams and non-technical stakeholders.

Essential Skills:
  • Advanced GA4
  • Advanced Google Tag Manager
  • Advanced Google BigQuery
  • Advanced SQL
  • Advanced Looker Studio
  • Advanced Google Apps Script / Google Sheets
  • GCP, including IAM and Cloud Functions
  • Experience with large-scale GTM migrations
  • Strong understanding of testing, automation, CI/CD and agile engineering
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills

Desirable: Optimizely or other A/B testing experience; experience working with large datasets and third-party technology suppliers.

job.title: DevOps/DataOps Engineers
job.description:
We're hiring experienced DevOps/DataOps Engineers to support major UK public sector digital programmes. You’ll work within multidisciplinary engineering teams to build, operate and improve secure, cloud-based data platforms supporting data, analytics and AI at scale.

What You'll Do:
  • Build and support DevOps/DataOps capabilities.
  • Develop automated CI/CD pipelines and data workflows.
  • Work with Kubernetes, Docker and cloud platforms.
  • Automate infrastructure using Terraform and/or Ansible.
  • Implement monitoring, observability and platform reliability.
  • Support secure deployments, including restricted environments.
  • Work with engineers, architects and delivery teams to deliver scalable solutions.

What We're Looking For:
  • Strong commercial DevOps/DataOps experience.
  • Experience with Airflow, Prefect or Dagster.
  • Kubernetes and Docker experience.
  • Strong CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code skills.
  • Experience with AWS, Azure and/or GCP.
  • Knowledge of technologies such as Spark, Kafka or PostgreSQL.
  • Active SC Clearance is essential.

Experience in UK Government, regulated environments, data/AI platforms, Databricks or Snowflake would be advantageous.

job.title: Lead Technical Architect
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Architect to provide technical leadership on a major public sector cloud migration and hosting transformation programme.

This role will lead the technical disposition and migration strategy for a complex application estate transitioning from legacy data centre environments into cloud and hosted platforms. You will guide architectural decisions from discovery and design through migration, cutover, and operational acceptance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead migration and technical disposition strategies.
  • Assess application dependencies, infrastructure requirements, and migration constraints.
  • Provide technical leadership across discovery, design, migration, and cutover activities.
  • Drive decisions around re-hosting, re-platforming, and migration approaches.
  • Manage technical risks, assumptions, and architectural governance.
  • Collaborate with cloud, hosting, security, network, and engineering teams to ensure migration readiness.
  • Lead technical governance reviews and provide senior stakeholder reporting.

Essential Experience

  • Extensive experience as a Lead, Enterprise, Technical, or Migration Architect.
  • Proven delivery of large-scale cloud migration, hosting transformation, or data programmes.
  • Strong cloud architecture and migration expertise.
  • Experience managing complex application estates within multi-supplier environments.
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure, networking, security, resilience, and operational readiness.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Active SC Clearance (or ability to obtain it).

Desirable Experience

  • Experience delivering programmes within Central Government or highly regulated environments.
  • Knowledge of legacy technologies including Oracle, WebLogic, AIX, Solaris, Windows, Linux, COBOL, and IIS.
  • Experience with large-scale lift-and-shift migration programmes.

job.title: Platform/DevOps Engineer
job.description:
We're looking for an experienced Platform/DevOps Engineer to join a project that underpins one of the UK's largest and most critical digital platforms. 

This is a hands-on engineering role suited to someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges, building high-quality automation and continuously improving large-scale cloud platforms.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, build and maintain cloud infrastructure and platform services in AWS
  • Deliver infrastructure and configuration through Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD pipelines
  • Support networking, connectivity and security across the platform, including firewalls, proxies and allowlisting
  • Implement and maintain platform observability through logs, metrics and alerting
  • Contribute to platform security, patching and data protection initiatives
  • Develop and maintain reusable infrastructure tooling and platform capabilities
  • Support and collaborate with tenant service teams and wider platform engineering teams
  • Improve platform reliability, scalability and developer experience
  • Coach and support engineers, promoting DevOps and software engineering best practices

Core Skills & Experience:
  • Strong DevOps and software engineering background
  • Proven experience designing and delivering cloud infrastructure in AWS
  • Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code expertise
  • Hands-on CI/CD pipeline design and implementation experience
  • Ability to design technical solutions within complex enterprise architectures
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical and investigation skills
  • Experience working collaboratively within Agile delivery teams
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Passion for engineering quality, automation and continuous improvement

AWS Experience:
  • Compute
  • Networking & Content Delivery
  • Storage
  • Databases
  • Security & Identity
  • Operations & Monitoring
  • Developer Tooling
  • Application Integration
  • Knowledge of the AWS Well-Architected Framework is highly desirable.

Technical Skills:
  • Terraform
  • CloudFormation
  • Python
  • Groovy
  • Shell Scripting
  • Jenkins
  • AWS Services & Tooling
  • Infrastructure Automation & Platform Engineering
